description: If you report on date-based metrics in Power BI, matrix tables and bar charts hide the seasonality, weekday, and hour-of-day patterns that drive business decisions. ProCalendar Heatmap helps you turn daily and hourly data into one calendar view that shows when activity happens - across days, months, fiscal quarters, multiple years, and hours of the week. Use ProCalendar Heatmap to spot demand peaks and quiet periods at a glance, compare seasonality year-over-year, surface the impact of holidays and weekends on operations, and find the busiest hours of the week without building five separate visuals. For example, bind a date column and a value, and ProCalendar Heatmap renders a GitHub-style annual heatmap, a familiar month calendar, or a 7 x 24 operational heatmap - all from the same data. Unlike matrix workarounds, abandoned calendar visuals, or single-mode heatmaps, ProCalendar Heatmap is built for enterprise calendar analytics: five rendering modes in one visual, fiscal-year and holiday awareness, manual color-scale domains with out-of-range colors, multi-metric split cells, and Canvas rendering for large date ranges.
